payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.14 — in-app update reliability + logging.

The update helper now force-releases the exe lock (kills any leftover SecureSH.exe) before swapping, and logs every step to %LOCALAPPDATA%\SecureSH\update.log. Download this build manually; once on it, the in-app update should work, and if not the log shows exactly why.

Includes the full UI redesign, RDP (incl. xrdp/standard-security), WebRTC/H.264/JPEG Remote Desktop with audio, Security panel + first-run vault.
